name: Akaza
background_note: Green, not magenta: Akaza's vest is magenta-pink and his hair pink, so a magenta key would eat them (the roster-v1 art used green too). common.cutout keys it.

ruler.note: Akaza is a tall, muscular adult (about 7 heads in the prompts). Runtime heights follow the official character data (Fanbook, as quoted by the Kimetsu no Yaiba Fandom wiki and pixiv encyclopedia): Tanjiro 165 cm, Zenitsu 164.5 cm, Akaza 173 cm, Nezuko 153 cm. Tanjiro and Zenitsu stand 340 px, so Akaza stands 340 x 173 / 165 = 356 px (tests/fate_revision_tests.gd: Akaza stays taller than both).
ruler.scale_note: Measured 2026-10-16 with anatomy.head (hair_lit rule) on the approved key (candidate 3, references/approved-idle-candidate.png, 493 x 828 with its padding): hair top to chin 132 px, stance 796 px; on the v3 model sheet's front view: hair top to chin 141, hair top to sole 960 (6.8 heads). Runtime head = 356 x 141 / 960 = 52.3 px (Tanjiro 61, Zenitsu 60: an adult drawn at 6.8 heads), key scale 52.3 / 132 = 0.396: the brawler idle stands about 315 px in game and upright 356 (the key's upright height is 960 x 132 / 141 = 899 px, so idle_vs_upright = 0.886). Checkpoint 1 (2026-10-16): the user chose candidate 3; the checkpoint-1 estimates (129 / 146 / 959, 370 px standing, idle about 349 px) were read by eye before the official heights were applied.
ruler.production_note: Checkpoint 3 pilot: the model draws Akaza's production frames with a larger head than the key: hair top to sole over the head ruler is 8.11 on the key but 7.51-7.87 on frames drawn in the same guard (stand_light 1 and 6, air_type 1 and 9), so head-ruler scaling left his body 6-8 percent shorter than the idle (walk 10 percent). Generated sheets therefore aim at a runtime head 1.07 times the key's (median of those guard frames, 1.03-1.08): the body matches the idle and the head is about 3 px larger. A prompt line with the key's proportions (prompt.proportions) helped only slightly; a size-guide reference made it worse.

palette.note: Material targets are measured from the approved v3 idle key at run time (process.canonical); the colour classes are "anatomy" and "materials" below.

identity: Akaza (Upper Rank Three demon): a tall, muscular young man about 7 heads tall, broad shoulders, a narrow waist and long legs; short spiky bright pink hair; golden-yellow eyes with small dark pupils (no writing in the eyes); pale skin covered with dark navy-blue line tattoos: horizontal stripes across the face, the neck, the chest, the abdomen, both arms and both legs, and one vertical line down the middle of the chest and abdomen; both hands entirely navy-blue (the tattoo covers them) with red fingernails; a short open sleeveless magenta-pink vest that ends above the waist, showing the bare chest and abs; a navy-blue sash tied at the waist with two long ends hanging in front; very wide white trousers gathered tightly at the ankles; barefoot with red toenails; a ring of large dark-blue beads round each ankle. He fights bare-handed and never carries a weapon.
style: Crisp premium anime ink outlines with consistent line weight, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, modern 2D fighting-game sprite finish.

canon.portrait: Face, eyes, pink hair and the navy face tattoos
canon.colours: hair bright pink #db568c; vest magenta-pink #b24c78; skin pale #decfc5; tattoo lines, sash and hands navy #284365; trousers white #e0dee0 with light grey shading; ankle beads deep blue #134a93; finger and toe nails red. The tattoo stripes keep the same spacing and thickness on every view.
canon.model_pose: relaxed neutral standing, arms slightly away from the body with the hands half open, a calm confident face with a slight smile.
candidates: Column 1, Destructive Death: Compass Needle stance: a very wide, low horse stance, knees deeply bent and turned out, the torso upright and leaning slightly forward; both arms spread out low to his sides, hands open like claws with the fingers spread; a fierce confident grin, eyes wide.

Column 2, martial arts guard: side-on stance with the left foot forward, knees slightly bent, weight on the rear leg, the heels lightly raised as if bouncing; the lead hand an open vertical palm at chin height, the rear hand a fist in front of the chest; a calm smile, eyes on the opponent.

Column 3, brawler stance (closest to his old idle): a medium-wide stance, both hands raised in front of the chest as half-closed claws, elbows out, the torso leaning slightly forward; a confident grin.

All three: bare-handed with no weapon; the navy line tattoos clearly visible on the face, neck, chest, arms and legs; the short magenta vest open; the navy sash with its long hanging ends; the wide white trousers; the blue ankle beads; barefoot.

prompt.note: Production rulers measured on the approved key at checkpoint 2: brawler stance 800 px, upright 900 px (model sheet proportion at the key's head), hair top to chin 132 px. He is unarmed, so the weapon line names his hands and the edit defaults change only his arms and hands. proportions (checkpoint 3): the pilot drew him about 10 percent shorter than the key at the same head size (a larger head relative to the body), so the prompt adds the key's own head : torso : leg lengths.
prompt.katana: he is UNARMED in every drawing: no sword, no scabbard and no weapon of any kind; both hands are bare, entirely navy-blue with red fingernails, as in input image 1.
prompt.katana_edit: he is UNARMED: no sword, no scabbard and no weapon; both hands are bare, navy-blue with red fingernails.
prompt.edit_keep: the size and the position of the figure in its column, the head, face and hair, the torso and the vest, the sash, both legs, both feet, the ankle beads, the line weight and the colours
prompt.edit_change: his two arms and his hands
prompt.effects: shockwaves, energy, snowflake sigils, trails or speed lines
prompt.proportions: measured on input image 1: hair top to chin 132 px, chin to the top of the sash 194 px, the sash to the soles 466 px (1 : 1.5 : 3.5 head lengths). He is a tall adult with a SMALL head on broad shoulders, a long torso and long legs; draw every frame with exactly these proportions, the head exactly as small as in input image 1, never a larger head or a shorter torso or legs.

anatomy.note: Provisional, measured on the roster-v1 model sheet: re-check on the approved key at checkpoint 2. Inclusive OpenCV HSV boxes. His pink hair shares its hue with the magenta vest, so hair_cut keeps only pink beyond the chin (as Zenitsu's gold). His chest and abs are bare skin, so the face blob may join the neck and chest across gaps in the tattoo lines; the head ruler must be checked on the key. uniform = the white trousers (the largest costume mass, at the hips). hair_lit: the lit hair reaches V 235+ on about half its pixels (key 50%, production 54-58%); the vest tops out near V 205 on the key but some production sheets light it to V 215-223, so the threshold is 235 (215 took a lit vest for the head).

materials.note: Provisional. Vest and tattoo navy are locked with the trousers and the skin; hair is QA only.

awakening.note: Approved at checkpoint 1 (Jutsu Development: Compass Needle): the navy tattoo lines, sash, hands and ankle beads brighten toward a luminous blue (Lab lightness +16, chroma x1.5, tried against +9 / x1.35 and +24 / x1.6 on the idle at checkpoint 2); alpha untouched, so every pixel stays where the base drawing put it. The royal-blue flame outline (blue-violet until the checkpoint 4 review) is drawn in game by vfx/akaza/compass.gd, so there is no baked rim.

qa.note: idle_vs_upright measured on the approved key (candidate 3, the brawler stance): 796 / 899. upright: standing frames ("upright_frames") vs the idle, centred on 1 / 0.886 = 1.13. stance: clips that keep the guard (walk), 0.95-1.2 of the idle. head_outlier_limit: an upright sheet whose head scale is this far off the clip median takes the median (round_victory's last sheet turns the face up and away; height-matching it to a bowed-head frame made it 12 percent larger).

guard_anchor.note: Checkpoint 4 review: the head ruler follows the head the model drew, and its size against the body changes from sheet to sheet (5B came out 14-22 percent larger, the Crown-Splitter landing 12 percent smaller, the super endings 5 percent larger), so moves popped in and out of the idle. process.guard_anchor scales sheets with a guard frame (frames naming the approved guard; all frames of a stance clip) so those frames match the idle in the geometric mean of height and silhouette area (sqrt of its pixels); other sheets take the clip median and keep their median area inside "area" (upright sheets pulled to the nearest edge unless the torso, head centre to the sash band, clearly disagrees; flips and jumps only made smaller; lying sheets untouched). Second review: Manyo, jC, the 236 and the landings still read larger at 1.05-1.2 of the idle area, hence the narrower band.
